page_title: PAR 3-2 MET | Paris FC v Metz 31/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Nouha Dicko (Paris FC) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
90+5' Ibou Sane (Metz) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+4' Gauthier Hein (Metz) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. Metz have been awarded a corner kick.
90+3' A clever short pass gives Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' That's the end of the game for Idrissa Gueye, who is replaced by Brian Madjo (Metz).
90' Stephane Gilli prepares a substitution. Vincent Marchetti is replaced by Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC).
90' The manager makes a subsitution with Nouha Dicko (Paris FC) coming on for Moses Simon.
90' It's time for a substitution. Jessy Deminguet (Metz) comes on in place of Boubacar Traore.
87' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jonathan Fischer comes off the line to clear the ball away.
87' The corner from Ibou Sane (Metz) is hurriedly cleared.
87' A pass into the penalty area from Ibou Sane (Metz) is intercepted by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Metz.
82' Moses Simon (Paris FC) is able to continue to play.
81' Moses Simon (Paris FC) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' Sadibou Sane (Metz) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alpha Toure (Metz) is coming onto the pitch as Terry Yegbe cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Thibault De Smet has picked up an injury and is replaced by Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC).
77' Terry Yegbe (Metz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

72' Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
69' A clumsy foul by Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) and Gael Angoula blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Paris FC.
69' Otavio (Paris FC) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

67' 3 - 2 GOAL! Maxime Lopez finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Moses Simon (Paris FC), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 3:2.
66' Here is a change. Willem Geubbels is going off and Stephane Gilli gives the last tactical orders to Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC).
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) will replace Adama Camara.
64' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 18:11. The current number of shots on goal is 5:2.
64' Idrissa Gueye (Metz) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
62' Stephane Le Mignan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ibou Sane (Metz) replacing Giorgi Abuashvili.
62' Substitution. Georgiy Tsitaishvili makes way for Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz).
61' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
59' Ilan Kebbal sprays a pass out to Adama Camara (Paris FC), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar.
59' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) plays a through ball but overhits it.

57' Samir Chergui (Paris FC) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Jonathan Fischer makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
56' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post.
54' 2 - 2 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Boubacar Traore (Metz), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 2:2.
52' 2 - 1 Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) meets a perfect cross from Moses Simon deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:1.
51' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Paris FC.
50' Now Paris FC have a corner.
50' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
49' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) takes it short.
49' Moses Simon (Paris FC) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. Paris FC force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' Moses Simon (Paris FC) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he sends his effort over the crossbar.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Koffi Kouao (Metz) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kevin Trapp, who smothers the ball.
45+3' 1 - 1 Goal! Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Jonathan Fischer.
45+2' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+1' Sadibou Sane (Metz) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
45+1' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Paris FC!
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Referee Gael Angoula makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Paris FC. Let’s see what happens!
43' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
43' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

42' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Paris FC force their opponents to concede a corner.
42' Half-chance! Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) plays a pass into the box, but Jonathan Fischer reacts well to snuff out the attack.
42' Moses Simon (Paris FC) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
40' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) whips in a cross from the corner, but Jonathan Fischer is well positioned and punches the ball away.
39' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) takes the corner with a short pass.
38' Idrissa Gueye (Metz) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
34' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Willem Geubbels (Paris FC). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the left post and is cleared to safety.
33' Total attempts – 8:6. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:1.
31' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) takes the corner which is cleared.
29' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
28' The resulting corner from Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) comes to nothing.

28' Jonathan Fischer pulls off a great save to deny Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. Paris FC earn a corner.
27' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
27' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
27' Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Paris FC.
26' Gauthier Hein finds Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
25' A wild pass somehow finds Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.

22' 0 - 1 Gauthier Hein produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Sadibou Sane (Metz) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball into the top right corner. What a brilliant finish. 0:1.
22' Gauthier Hein (Metz) takes the corner.
22' Terry Yegbe (Metz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Metz have a corner.
19' A cross from Moses Simon (Paris FC) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
18' Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

16' Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Jonathan Fischer pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The rebound finds Adama Camara (Paris FC) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
16' The possession of the ball – 51:49.
13' Idrissa Gueye (Metz) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
12' The resulting corner, taken by Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz), comes to nothing.
11' Koffi Kouao (Metz) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Metz.
10' Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
10' There's an opportunity for Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
10' The resulting corner from Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) is cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Metz.
9' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Metz are awarded a corner kick.

6' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Moses Simon (Paris FC).
4' Samir Chergui (Paris FC) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
4' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
3' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball is out of play. Paris FC win a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Metz will have the kick-off.
Gael Angoula is introduced as the referee for today's match.
